statement: In all Python files outside third_party/, code must not trigger flake8-bugbear B checks (likely bugs and design problems such as mutable default arguments, bare except, loop-variable closures).
In all Python files outside third_party/, code must not trigger flake8 C checks (mccabe complexity C901 and flake8-comprehensions C4xx, e.g. unnecessary list/dict/set calls or comprehensions).
In all Python files outside third_party/, code must not trigger pycodestyle E errors other than the explicitly ignored codes.
In all Python files outside third_party/, code must not trigger pyflakes F checks (e.g. undefined names, unused imports, redefinitions) other than the explicitly ignored codes.

In all Python files outside third_party/, logging calls must not build their message with str.format(), %-formatting, string concatenation or f-strings (flake8-logging-format G checks); pass arguments to the logger instead.
In all Python files outside third_party/, str.format() format strings must not use unindexed/implicit positional fields or mismatched arguments (flake8-string-format P checks).

In all Python files outside third_party/, code must not trigger flake8-simplify SIM1xx checks (e.g. nested ifs that can be merged, needless if/else returning bools, use of contextlib.suppress, combinable isinstance calls).
In all Python files outside third_party/, code must not trigger flake8-mypy T4xx type-checking errors.
In all Python files outside third_party/, code must not trigger pycodestyle W warnings other than the explicitly ignored codes.

In all Python files outside third_party/, code must not trigger flake8-bugbear opinionated B9xx checks (e.g. B901 return in generator, B902 bad first argument to method, B903 data class candidates, B904 raise without from inside except, B950 line too long).

quote: max-line-length = 120  # E501 is not flexible enough, we're using B950 instead
statement: In all Python files outside third_party/, lines must not exceed the 120-character limit (enforced via B950, which tolerates ~10% overshoot, instead of E501).
In all Python files, pycodestyle E203 (whitespace before ':' or ',') is not enforced.
In all Python files, pycodestyle E305 (expected 2 blank lines after class or function definition) is not enforced.
In all Python files, module-level imports are allowed to appear after other code (pycodestyle E402 'module level import not at top of file' is not enforced).

quote: # E501 is not flexible enough, we're using B950 instead; ignore = ...,E501,...
statement: In all Python files, pycodestyle E501 (line too long) is not enforced; B950 is used for line length instead.
In all Python files, direct type comparisons such as type(x) == T are allowed (pycodestyle E721 'do not compare types, use isinstance()' is not enforced).
In all Python files, ambiguous single-letter variable names l, O and I are allowed (pycodestyle E741 is not enforced).
In all Python files, names that may be undefined or come from star imports are allowed (pyflakes F405 is not enforced).
In all Python files, pyflakes F821 (undefined name) is not enforced.
In all Python files, local variables that are assigned but never used are allowed (pyflakes F841 is not enforced).
In all Python files, pyflakes F999 (catch-all pyflakes message) is not enforced.
In all Python files, pycodestyle W503 (line break before binary operator) is not enforced.
In all Python files, pycodestyle W504 (line break after binary operator) is not enforced.

quote: # C408 ignored because we like the dict keyword argument syntax; ignore = ...,C408,...
statement: In all Python files, dict()/list()/tuple() calls such as dict(a=1, b=2) are allowed instead of literals (flake8-comprehensions C408 is not enforced because the team likes dict keyword-argument syntax).
In all Python files, pycodestyle E302 (expected 2 blank lines) is not enforced.
In all Python files, pycodestyle W291 (trailing whitespace) is not enforced by flake8.
In all Python files, pycodestyle E303 (too many blank lines) is not enforced.
In all Python files, pycodestyle E226 (missing whitespace around arithmetic operator) is not enforced.
In all Python files, pycodestyle E265 (block comment should start with '# ') is not enforced.
In Python files checked by the pre-commit flake8 hook (excluding dist/ and third_party/), unused imports are allowed (pyflakes F401 is not enforced).
In Python files checked by the pre-commit flake8 hook (excluding dist/ and third_party/), redefinition of an unused name is allowed (pyflakes F811 is not enforced).
In Python files checked by the pre-commit flake8 hook, pycodestyle E231 (missing whitespace after ',', ';' or ':') is not enforced.
In Python files checked by the pre-commit flake8 hook, pycodestyle E225 (missing whitespace around operator) is not enforced.
In Python files checked by the pre-commit flake8 hook, multiple statements on one line separated by a semicolon are allowed (pycodestyle E702 is not enforced).
In all Python files, imports of first-party modules must be absolute (e.g. from cosmos_transfer1.utils import ...) and must not use relative imports (from . / from ..).

quote: id: black, args: [--line-length=120]; [tool.black] line-length = 120, target_version = ['py310'], exclude = 'third_party'
statement: In all Python files outside dist/ and third_party/, code must be formatted with black at line length 120 targeting Python 3.10.

quote: id: isort, args: [--line-length=120]; [tool.isort] profile = "black", known_third_party = ["third_party"], skip = ["third_party"], line_length = 120
statement: In all Python files outside third_party/, imports must be sorted by isort with the black profile at line length 120, treating third_party as a third-party package.
In all files except tests/*/fixtures/, lines must not end with trailing whitespace (Markdown hard line breaks excepted).
In all files except tests/*/fixtures/, files must end with exactly one newline.
In the repository, newly added files must not exceed 2000 KB.

quote: Cosmos IP header checker/fixer: header = ["SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) 2025 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.", "SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0", ...]; header = [("# " + line if line else "#") for line in header] for .py/.yaml
statement: In cosmos_transfer1/auxiliary, cosmos_transfer1/diffusion and cosmos_transfer1/utils, every .py and .yaml file (except __init__.py and paths containing 'prompt_upsampler') must begin with the '#'-commented NVIDIA SPDX Apache-2.0 license header (SPDX-FileCopyrightText ... 2025 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES, SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0, Apache License text) as its first lines, followed by exactly one blank line and then non-blank content.
enforced_by: scripts/ip_header.py (run by scripts/format.sh in the Lint workflow)

quote: elif ext in (".c", ".cpp", ".cu", ".h", ".cuh"): header = ["/*"] + [(" * " + line if line else " *") for line in header] + [" */"]
statement: In cosmos_transfer1/auxiliary, cosmos_transfer1/diffusion and cosmos_transfer1/utils, every .c, .cpp, .cu, .h and .cuh file (except paths containing 'prompt_upsampler') must begin with the NVIDIA SPDX Apache-2.0 license header as a /* ... */ block comment with ' * ' line prefixes, followed by one blank line.
enforced_by: scripts/ip_header.py (run by scripts/format.sh in the Lint workflow)
